import copy
import json
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
from playwright.sync_api import TimeoutError as PlaywrightTimeout
import browser

EVIDENCE = Path('/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14042403')

class FontScreenshotRecoveryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.item = json.loads((EVIDENCE / 'q-126168-before.json').read_text())
        cls.report = json.loads((EVIDENCE / 'diagnostics/1791451184958654481/error.json').read_text())
        if 'waiting for fonts to load' not in cls.report['message']:
            raise AssertionError('Expected saved font-loading failure')
        if cls.item['assets']:
            raise AssertionError('Fixture requires the observed asset-free question')

    def fixtures(self, outcomes):
        scope = Mock()
        scope.evaluate.return_value = copy.deepcopy(self.item)
        scope.locator.return_value.all.return_value = []
        scope.screenshot.side_effect = outcomes
        reader = SimpleNamespace(pacer=Mock(), check=Mock(), image_responses={})
        return reader, scope

    def read(self, reader, scope):
        with patch.object(Path, 'mkdir'), patch.object(browser, 'atomic_json'):
            return browser.CaptureBrowser.read(reader, scope, EVIDENCE, 'offline-regression')

    def test_saved_original_failure(self):
        scope = Mock()
        scope.screenshot.side_effect = PlaywrightTimeout(self.report['message'])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(PlaywrightTimeout, 'waiting for fonts to load'):
            scope.screenshot(path='unused.png')

    def test_transient_font_failure_recovers_with_pacing(self):
        reader, scope = self.fixtures([PlaywrightTimeout(self.report['message']), None])
        item, screenshot = self.read(reader, scope)
        self.assertEqual(item, self.item)
        self.assertEqual(screenshot, EVIDENCE / 'offline-regression.png')
        self.assertEqual(scope.screenshot.call_count, 2)
        reader.pacer.backoff.assert_called_once_with(1)
        reader.check.assert_called_once_with()
        for call in scope.screenshot.call_args_list:
            self.assertEqual(call.kwargs, {'path': str(screenshot)})

    def test_exhausted_font_retry_does_not_claim_capture(self):
        reader, scope = self.fixtures([PlaywrightTimeout(self.report['message']) for _ in range(3)])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(PlaywrightTimeout, 'waiting for fonts to load'):
            self.read(reader, scope)
        self.assertEqual(scope.screenshot.call_count, 3)
        self.assertEqual([c.args for c in reader.pacer.backoff.call_args_list], [(1,), (2,)])
        self.assertEqual(reader.check.call_count, 2)

    def test_visibility_failure_is_not_bypassed(self):
        reader, scope = self.fixtures([PlaywrightTimeout('element is not visible')])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(PlaywrightTimeout, 'element is not visible'):
            self.read(reader, scope)
        self.assertEqual(scope.screenshot.call_count, 1)
        reader.pacer.backoff.assert_not_called()
        reader.check.assert_not_called()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
